result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, in the path-pattern constants near the top. I ran the codeanalyzer tests matching `*Scoping*` and they pass. I didn't add tests for the new `.htm`, `.xml`, `.js` and `build-gradle.js` cases, so the fix itself is untested.

- **Generated HTML pages:** the pattern listed `html` twice, so I changed `(html|html|xhtml)` to `(html|htm|xhtml)`. The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules now cover `.htm`, and `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **.NET assembly docs and generated JS:** `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` required a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JS scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*-gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. The `.*[.]gradle` rule for `build.gradle` is unchanged.

Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope. The rules still need the matching content line (pkgdown, Doxygen, `<meta name="generator">`, `<doc>` or `// Generated by`) within the line limits above.
